claims.statement: MODE/SUBTYPE (type) tuning rule — GENERAL across all effects (plate/'140' is the instance): a mode + model/subtype (Params::type[mode] axis, numTypes(), defaultDialsForType(), UI type chip e.g. the '140' Plate chip = mode 0 type 0 in V2 mode order) MAY carry its own knob defaults and its own tone law tuned against its own reference IR — permissive (CAN, not MUST) — but it must NEVER override the generic/shared path or the OTHER modes (bit-identical pins keep them separate: shared comb lines, norm/wash, convolver, and 15-digit pins for every other mode). defaultDialsForType currently returns false (no type override shipped yet). The same rule applies to delay subtypes (Straight/Mod/BBD/Mem), compressor subtypes, chorus/tape subtypes — each may have its own defaults and law (tuned to ITS reference) provided the generic path stays separate.

Spring (mode 1) metallic body + boing: the incommensurate resonator cluster (kSpringR1..R3 gains, IR-driven ears-pass — the 1.3–2.8 kHz pings lifted ~+4 dB RELATIVE to the 220–900 Hz body modes, ping + sparkle) replaces the old single-2-kHz boing ring, which is DISABLED (kSpringBoingGain = 0.000, 'replaced by the R1/R2/R3 cluster'; earlier value 0.028). Body gain kSpringBodyGain = 0.018 (modest — 'body is under the metal, not over it').

CONSIDERED & DECLINED (2026-10-13 final pass; keep the full block; do NOT re-try blind): (1) in-loop darkening/body (comb +4.7 to +10 dB, fb-capped gain, one unstable); (2) 2nd-order biquad out-stages at low fc MEASURED UNSTABLE (unnormalised peaking; pole radius 1.127 to NaN), DC-DEAD (lowpass form DC gain 0.035 = a resonator not a lowpass; 6-12 kHz passed uncut), or wrong-shape (a 240 Hz peaking at 600 Hz-1.2 kHz) -- ONLY 1st-order stages (y += a*(x-y), a = 1-exp(-2*pi*fc/fs)) are stable and DC-exact; if ever required: JUCE BiquadCoefficients AND numeric pole radius < 1 AND DC gain checks before shipping; (3) body-ADD out-stage (worked +4 dB but 50 % NEUTRAL rebalance already reproduces the EMT body -- REMOVED); (4) denser onset pings: L1 dense-9-tap bank 42.7 to 29.5, Hadamard 42.7 to 25.1 (more in-band energy = higher floor = thinner peaks); (5) C3 near-miss (5 uneven taps sum 1.14, whip 0.026 KEPT): only +2.5 dB ping (37.15 to 39.70) vs C (3 taps, whip 0.015: 37.15 to 45.66, within 0.9 dB of ref 46.60) -- the lever is the FLOOR (kPlateBrightOnset), not tap count or sum; (6) extra series-LPF stage for Size law (can only darken -- wrong direction for size 1 = brighter; its low-band swamps the body at high-freq tail offsets -- rejected in favor of the corner shift kPlateSizeCornerFrac); (7) trained M/S split (the Haas-offset mechanism already gives a documented bounded image, S-M -4.06 dB at width 1.0; a mid/side gain would be an unmeasured constant -- documented as the model's MEASURED difference instead); (8) value-matching the reference comb (19.39 vs EMT 140's 14.71: different cavity physics; the model's own comb law -- growth with its own decay -- is pinned relative to its own baseline per ticket no-forced-match).

Each effect mode is a distinct DSP engine, not a preset, and its per-mode law + every CONSIDERED-&-DECLINED item in docs/agents/dsp-invariants.md and docs/agents/ir-reverb-training.md is a user-eared CONTRACT pinned by tests in test/src/: effect_tests.cpp, convolution_reverb_tests.cpp, plate_comb_tests.cpp, plate_texture_tests.cpp, plate_family_tests.cpp, budget_convolver_cost_tests.cpp, and more -- do NOT silently simplify the law back to a naive form (e.g. Compressor ratio law: detent 4:1 is the bit-identical keeper anchor, do NOT simplify to (n-1)/R which treated R as softness = INVERTED; chorus/tremolo kNumWaves must stay 5 together; BBD fc ~ 1/T from the SLEWED base tap). The delay design lives in plugin/docs/delay-modes.md; the IR training protocol + the plate/'140' instance + the biquad landmine live in docs/agents/ir-reverb-training.md.

The R2 shared-Mod contract (2026-10-15, SHIPPED at the thirteenth/final cut, commit 1aa620e): `Reverb::Params::sharedMod` (0..1, clamped in setParams) gates `processSharedModSmear` -- a post-mix, wet-unity ADDED multi-voice chorus layer on the WET reverb output (`out = wet + amt*dsum`; NEVER a crossfade, which the ear rejected for volume drop + anti-phase clicks). Mechanism constants (plugin/include/Reverb.h, region ~1050-1131 + processSharedModSmear at ~1913): kModVoices = 7 (6 delay lines v=1..6 of incommensurate depth/rate + the undelayed voice), kSharedModDepthMs = 18.0 (deepest voice at sharedMod 1), kModWriteTauMs = 80.0 (the CLICK FIX: ring-write one-pole smoothing on each voice's ring write), kModChorusAmt = 3.0 (layer amount, measured), a 6 kHz 1-pole/tap-filter per voice, and a smoothstep output taper so the layer is inaudible below ~50 % Mod. The fixed-sine Mod LFO uses `waveValue(0, phase)` (wave 0 = exact sine, the Digital read-tap anchor). OFF (sharedMod == 0, the default) the WHOLE path (incl. the per-voice biquad + delay state) is never entered -> all 6 modes bit-identical to the pre-R2 engine (pinned by R2_SharedModZeroIsBitExactAllSixModes at 15-digit level). The per-mode kSmearAmt/kFbDriftAmt swirl laws are NEVER scaled by the Mod knob (always-on, unchanged, bit-identity anchor). The standing rule (user m02589): ALWAYS MEASURE DSP changes sonically (probe/sweep tests in the real engine) -- never ship an ear-guess without the measured ladder. Ticket: docs/tickets/complete/reverb-dry-mod-width-swing.md.

R3 WIDTH LAW (2026-10-16, SHIPPED — supersedes any description of the reverb width as merely a per-bank tap-length drift): width is a TWO-LAYER control, coherent in all 6 reverb modes. LAYER 1 (RETAINED, bit-exact to pre-R3; present at the plain/Digital/Spring/Plate sites — Room/Chamber/Hall never used it): widthTapScaleFor(ch, numChannels) = (ch==0) ? (1.0 − 0.05*width) : (1.0 + 0.05*width) with kMaxWidthSpread = 0.05, i.e. ch-0 taps 5pct·width shorter, ch-1 5pct·width longer — the spectral-decorrelation baseline (a first R3 cut removed it and 1ch mono pins moved; it was restored). LAYER 2 (NEW, the ticket's 'match the convolver' ask): applyWidthHaas in plugin/include/Reverb.h (~:869) — a post-mix convolver-MATCHING Haas/M-S stage mirroring ConvolutionReverb's mono-IR spread constants kHaasDelayMs = 3.5 ms (kWidthHaasDelayMs) / kHaasDepth = 0.55 (kWidthHaasDepth), applied at EVERY mode's exit (7 call sites: plain ~:932, Digital ~:942, Spring ~:952, Plate ~:962, Room ~:974, Chamber ~:998, Hall ~:1087) BEFORE processSharedModSmear. Per sample: mid = 0.5(L+R) is stored in a per-instance power-of-2 ring (whRing_/whMask_/whWrite_, sized in prepare(), cleared in reset()); half = 0.5*width*kWidthHaasDepth*mid[d samples ago]*0.5; L += 2*half, R −= 2*half — i.e. side = width*0.55*mid[3.5 ms behind], split ± onto L/R. Properties: SUM-EXACT — (L+R)/2 unchanged at every sample, so every mono/level pin stayed green; GATED (widthHaasOn_ = 2ch buffer && width>0 && sampleRate_>0) — width 0 = bit-exact no-op (zero flops) and 1ch buffers (the production per-lane mode) are width-inert in layer 2, keeping only layer 1 (bit-identical to pre-R3). Net effect: Room/Chamber/Hall NOW respond to Width (previously inert); the stereo image is the convolver's Haas pair instead of a synthetic tap-length drift. P5 (PlateKnobLaw.StereoImageAtWidth1, test/src/plate_family_tests.cpp:716) re-measured under the two-layer law: tail [1.0, 2.5 s) at 2ch width 1.0 = mid −21.40 dB, side −24.91 dB = side-over-mid −3.51 dB (the pre-R3 tapScale-only measurement was −4.06 dB; the test's soft assertions sideE<midE and midE>−90 stay intact). DspTests 487/487 green; the reverb tile goldens (EffectTile kCompactKnobFace 32 px + label 12.0, the R3 UI addendum) were re-shot and verified at 0 px. Ticket: docs/tickets/complete/reverb-dry-mod-width-swing.md.

T-DAT-001 (2026-10-17, supersedes the pre-DAT Plate engine map, kNumModes=6 and decay caps kMaxDecayMsByMode {2500,2500,2000,3000,3500,2750} ms retained at Reverb.h:51-57; UI chips mode-row {PLT,SPR,RM,CHM,HALL,DIG} EffectTile.cpp:142, Digital subtypes {DIG,SPR,PLT,SML,CHM,HAL} :154). THE NEW PLT ENGINE is a clean-room MIT PORT of RSAlgorithmicVerb-main (MIT, Source/DattorroVerb.cpp, Dattorro 1997; attribution at the port site ~Reverb.h:2225 per the AGENTS.md MIT-port rule - structure AND constants ported, restructured to repo style, zero-latency preserved). Dispatch (Reverb.h ~:1131): mode 0 ALWAYS runs processDat() (default + only engine; no bright/bloom arm on the PLT face - Bright/Bloom moved off the visible face). processDat = two mono tanks (one per channel) with golden fig-8 A/B crossfeed, 4 input all-pairs (gains 0.98/0.98/0.83/0.83, capped under 1 for the z=-1 pole), APF delay bases in SAMPLES x(0.25+1.5*size), node-tap splits per side (c==0 vs c==1 tap sets x0.6), pre-ring Early taps 2/5/9 ms x early, Tone one-pole dampings 800*16^tone Hz on d0/d2, Air 4.5 kHz shelf (1+6*air) blending the accumulator low-pass, LoCut one-pole HPF at 45 Hz (0 = bit-pass), in-LPF 13.5 kHz. THE DECAY KNOB drives the fig-8 loop multiplier datDec_ at all 6 decay sites: datDec_ = 0.15 + (0.82-0.15)*log10(clamp(decayMs,50,2500)/50)/log10(2500/50), UNIFORM 0.82 ceiling (setParams ~:889-897) - measured energy-growth-slope boundary is decaying<=0.84 / growing>=0.88 at every size; 0.82 = boundary minus margin. The 'runaway at size>=0.25' seen mid-hunt was an UNZEROED AudioBuffer in the probes (heap garbage streaming into the loop), not the engine. Width in the DAT arm: a width-gated M/S side-gain post stage (0.5*(L-R)*w; w=0 mono, w=1 full per-side image) instead of applyWidthHaas, then the shared R2 Mod stage (unchanged contract: wet-unity ADDED chorus layer, OFF = bit-exact via R2_SharedModZeroIsBitExactAllSixModes). Standing guards: suite DatGuards in test/src/dat_probe_tests.cpp (StableAcrossSizeDecayGrid, LongerDecayKeepsTheLongTail, LoCutDropsTheLowBand via a resonator-free DFT per-bin band meter, AirLiftsTheTopBand, WidthWidensThePlateImage, ModZeroIsBitPass).

LEGACY COMB PLATE (the 2026-10-13 '140' tuned law) survives ONLY on the Digital PLT entry (mode 5, type[5]==2, bright/bloom armed - Reverb.h:~1157 plateOn gate), bit-identical to the pre-T-DAT-001 engine: kPlateAirHzBright 4900 / kPlateAirHzDark 3600, kPlateAirStages 2, kPlateBodyHz 550, onset taps {14.2, 26.9, 51.3} ms, kPlateWashAp 0.62 / kPlateWashRef 0.244, kPlateBloomFrac 0.32, kPlateColorAmt 0.3, kPlateDecayLift 1.15, kPlateFbCeilingUp 0.965 (test hooks plateCeilTest_/plateLiftTest_), Size-law corner shift kPlateSizeCornerFrac 0.30 (size 1 = brighter, MEASURED direction). Baseline pins retained on that arm: level-law 93.95@2000 ms, comb cap 21.98@2500 ms (re-pinned tests now drive the mode5/type2 arm via plateLegacyP()/plateLegacyAt() helpers). All other modes bit-identical to pre-T-DAT. The CONSIDERED-&-DECLINED block (2026-10-13, docs/agents/ir-reverb-training.md + dsp-invariants.md) remains a contract for that arm.
